label.purpose: Fragment Mono caps for values of record: spec labels, statuses, counts, table heads (.arena-data).

nameplate.purpose: ARENA wordmark only: expanded caps via wdth 125 (.arena-nameplate).

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Menus, popovers, dialogs only. In-flow elements cast nothing (The Print Has No Shadows Rule).

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Hover, open, selection. No page-load choreography; global prefers-reduced-motion clamp in globals.css.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one Signal-filled decision per view.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--primary, oklch(0.5 0.16 33)); color: oklch(0.985 0.005 90); height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 4px; font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.5 0.16 33) 80%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: oklch(0.5 0.16 33); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.5 0.16 33 / 0.5); }

components.name: Outline Button

components.name: Chip of record

components.name: Field
components.description: Search and form field with the darker field rule.

components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 24px; background: oklch(0.24 0.012 260); padding: 0 16px; } .ds-nav-item { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; height: 40px; color: oklch(0.76 0.015 250); font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-decoration: none; transition: color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-nav-item:hover { color: oklch(0.955 0.004 110); } .ds-nav-item.is-active { color: oklch(0.955 0.004 110); } .ds-nav-item.is-active::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; height: 2px; background: oklch(0.64 0.16 36); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.955 0.004 110); outline-offset: -2px; }

narrative.overview: Arena is set in the graphic world of the mid-century European machine-works catalogue — cool coated paper, near-black ink, a strict grid, one vermilion signal colour, and technical diagrams where other publications would use photographs. It is a working tool first: scanability, density and familiar affordances outrank expression, and the brand lives in precise details. The product's honesty is the design's honesty: every visual is drawn evidence, every status is carried by geometry before hue, and fictional data is disclosed in the first pixels of every page.
keyCharacteristics: Cool mill-white ground with near-white plates; ink masthead and footer bookend every page
One vermilion signal for action and selection; everything else is ink, steel and rules
A single grotesque (Archivo) at all sizes, with Fragment Mono reserved for data
All imagery drawn as SVG line work — there is no photography and never will be
Severe but not brutalist: 4px corners, real borders, flat surfaces, tabular figures

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Vermilion marks action and selection, nothing else. If a screen is more than ~10% Signal, elements are claiming decisions they cannot make.

rules.name: The Two Reds Rule
rules.body: Signal (hue 33) acts; Crimson (hue 15) destroys, and only ever as tint + text. They never appear as visual peers on one surface.

rules.name: The Geometry Before Hue Rule
rules.body: No status may be encoded by colour alone. The mark, label or position changes first; the hue reinforces.

rules.name: The Mono Is Measurement Rule
rules.body: Fragment Mono appears only where a value is data — numbers, codes, statuses, labels of record. Never as a decorative technical voice for prose.

rules.name: The No Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Headings carry their own weight. No kicker or label sits above a heading.

rules.name: The Print Has No Shadows Rule
rules.body: If an element is in the page flow, it casts nothing. Only overlays float.

dos: Do route every colour through the semantic tokens in globals.css; raw hex in a component is a defect.
Do pair every status with the seal geometry or an explicit text label; hue is reinforcement, never the message.
Do use .arena-data for labels of record and tabular figures for any column of numbers.
Do keep one Signal-filled action per view and let outline/ghost carry the rest.
Do design list rows and tables before reaching for card grids; the catalogue is a register, not a mosaic.
Do keep both themes true: every new pair ≥4.5:1 (text) or ≥3:1 (affordance), checked in light and dark.
Do respect the motion budget: 150–250ms state transitions with the global reduced-motion clamp; no page-load choreography.
donts: Don't use photography, stock art, gradients-as-imagery, or emoji icons — evidence is drawn.
Don't ship violet/blue gradients, glassmorphism, Inter, cream+serif+terracotta, near-black+acid-accent, or broadsheet hairlines with zero radius.
Don't put a kicker/eyebrow above any heading, or number sections unless the sequence itself is information.
Don't repeat one identical card grid across pages — each surface derives its structure from its own data shape.
Don't touch frontend/src/app/globals.css or frontend/src/components/ui/** from a surface agent; request foundation changes instead.
Don't dress declared up as verified — visual weight must track the verification gradient, never invert it.
